change_email_body: Hi {name}, we received a request to change the email on your {brandName} account to {newEmail}. Confirm below to make the change. The link expires in one hour.
change_email_footer: If you didn't request this change, you can ignore this email and your email address won't change.
change_email_preview: Confirm the email change for your {brandName} account
delete_account_body: Hi {name}, we received a request to permanently delete your {brandName} account. This can't be undone. Confirm below to delete it. The link expires in one hour.
delete_account_footer: If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email and your account will stay active.
digest_footer: You can turn these emails off in your notification settings.
invitation_body: {inviterName} has invited you to collaborate in the {organizationName} organization.
invitation_footer: If you weren't expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.
invitation_reminder_body: {inviterName} invited you to collaborate in the {organizationName} organization. The invitation expires soon, so accept it while it's still valid.
invitation_reminder_preview: Reminder: {inviterName} invited you to join {organizationName} on {brandName}
magic_link_body: Hi {name}, click below to sign in to your {brandName} account. The link expires in five minutes and can be used once.
magic_link_footer: If you didn't request this link, you can ignore this email.
reset_password_body: Hi {name}, we received a request to reset the password for your {brandName} account. The link below expires in one hour.
reset_password_footer: If you didn't request a password reset, you can ignore this email. Your password won't change.
verify_email_body: Hi {name}, confirm this is your email address to finish setting up your {brandName} account. The link below expires in one hour.
verify_email_footer: If you didn't create an {brandName} account, you can ignore this email.
welcome_body: Hi {name}, your account is ready. Create an organization, invite your team, and start collaborating on tasks and notes in real time.
welcome_footer: If you didn't create this account, you can ignore this email.
